expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: In the promo banner, the headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white text on a very light mint-green background. The contrast is far below WCAG minimums, so the promo code and its conditions are nearly invisible. Only the 'Order now' button is clearly legible, so users see a call to action without the offer details it depends on.
